featured_reviews.name: ANIKET KUNDU
featured_reviews.review_text:
Subject: Heartfelt Appreciation & A Few Suggestions for CampusHunger!

To the entire team at CampusHunger The Daily Tiffin Service,

I am writing to express my immense satisfaction with your service. Your commitment to providing homely, fresh, and delicious food is truly commendable and is the primary reason I am a loyal customer.

The food consistently reminds me of home-cooked meals, which is a rare and valuable quality in a tiffin service. I am particularly a huge fan of your Chicken Curry and Fish Fry – both dishes are absolutely stellar and something I always look forward to.

As a passionate food lover, I also have a few suggestions for your menu that I believe would be wonderfully received. I would be absolutely thrilled if you could introduce special thalis such as Prawn Thali, Bombil Thali, Pomfret Thali, and Mutton Thali. I am also always eager to try any other regional fish recipes you might feature.

Finally, I want to applaud you for maintaining such high quality while keeping your prices affordable. This balance is invaluable for students and professionals alike.

Thank you for the great work. Please keep serving the good food!

Best regards,
Aniket Kundu

2) The other item sent as a vegetable was CHOLE! Is CHOLE A VEGETABLE?
3) After informing them that the second vegetable had not been sent, I was told it would be delivered in 10 minutes(I live close to the tiffin service place). It was delivered after almost an hour. featured_reviews.review_text: Whatever food charges displayed here are totally misleading. In each meal they add Rs. 40 as a delivery charge, though you agreed to pick it from them and not opting for delivery. That means Rs. 40 is hidden charges that they levy on each order.

featured_reviews.name: Renu Dodeja
featured_reviews.review_text: I received tiffin two days properly and on third day I received only sabzi and chapati was missing. I complained but no response received. I then stopped placing order but then too no action was taken. Pathetic service.

featured_reviews.name: anjali joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I highly recommend Health Bag Meal tiffin service! I ordered their tiffins for a month during a time when my husband and I were down with chicken gunya, and our cook was on long leave. Health Bag Meal truly was a lifesaver.

The food is hygienic, non-spicy, and absolutely delicious. Everything is delivered right to your doorstep in sealed bags, so there’s no spilling, mixing, or misplacement. The containers are microwave-safe, making it very convenient to reheat.

What impressed me most is the variety in the menu — no dish was repeated over the entire month! They also don’t use baking powder or baking soda, and we had zero digestion issues. The variety of vegetables and dals was particularly commendable.

Mr. Harish Sharma, the owner, is very courteous, always responds promptly and addresses the queries satisfactorily. On request, he provided vegetables without onion and garlic for my parents, and they loved them. On one occasion, there was a small mix-up in the order, but he promptly sent the correct vegetables again at no extra charge — a truly heartwarming gesture.

Overall, Health Bag Meal combines user-friendly, hygiene, and delicious home-style food with excellent customer service. I’ve already recommended them to many and I will continue to do so!

featured_reviews.name: Vidit Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been taking healthbag meal Tiffin services for more than 17 months and still their services as well as food quality remained top notch. Especially the owner Mr. Harish Sharma is such a generous person as he listens the customer request, complaints and he make sure that it will not be done in the near future. I would really recommend to opt for this tiffin services as in South Bombay you can’t get such a delicious homely cooked food at a quite decent price.

featured_reviews.name: Satya Nair Sandim
featured_reviews.review_text: I ordered the food and called home for Satyanarayan Pooja. Food, quality taste everything, amazing. Very tasty food. Our guests also enjoyed the food. On time delivery.

featured_reviews.name: Anushree Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text: This is more than just a tiffin service, The food is consistently good and well-packed, but what truly stands out is their service. They are always on time, and their communication is excellent. I've had a wonderful experience and can count on them for my daily meals. And the customer service is top-notch. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great, hassle-free meals.

featured_reviews.name: Akshata Khandekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Perfect Tiffin Service for a Busy Lifestyle!
I’ve been using this tiffin service for the past few months, and it has truly been a blessing in my hectic schedule. With work and other daily responsibilities, I hardly had the time or energy to cook nutritious meals — that’s where this service came to the rescue.

The food is always fresh, homely, and full of variety. It reminds me of a proper ghar ka khana, which is hard to find these days. The quality and hygiene are top-notch, portions are satisfying, and delivery is always on time, which I really appreciate.

It has taken a huge load off my shoulders and helped me maintain a healthy eating routine without compromising on taste or time. Highly recommend to anyone looking for reliable, homemade food delivered daily!

featured_reviews.name: Shounak Todankar
featured_reviews.review_text: This catering service is really good. They provide tiffin service, and the food quality as well quantity is extremely well. The major point is that the cost of the meals is really less and quality of the food is great! This is a good option for the bachelors...

featured_reviews.name: Elizabeth
featured_reviews.review_text:
If your looking for fresh and tasty homemade food in a good budget, this is the place to order from...I order mostly lunch for my mother in law and the food is simply amazing...their food packing is also very neat and clean...they follow all the special instructions given by us ...my mother in law is truly happy and satisfied with their service...She just loves all the sabjis offered in the food plate...says it's yummy and tasty😋

A special shout out to Mr. Swapnil for his courteous and friendly approach towards his customers and for his timely delivery...

Kudos to Pranamyaa Tiffin and catering services, God bless!! Keep up the good work👌👍

featured_reviews.name: Priya Kolhale
featured_reviews.review_text: The food is exceptionally delicious, and the service is excellent. Mr. Swapnil Sir’s courteous behaviour and sincere efforts towards customers are unmatched. The food is also delivered on time.

featured_reviews.name: Sourav Dutta
featured_reviews.review_text:
A great overall experience. Food tastes awesome, the packaging is great and hygiene is unmatched. The behaviour and efforts of Mr. Swapnil towards the customers is unmatched.

Definitely worth a try!

featured_reviews.name: Gargi kadam
featured_reviews.review_text: Best food service ,hygienic and also good in taste ,food is always on time never too late and never too early .All around really good and yummy too

name: ZAS Kitchen
description: Craving an authentic taste of Mumbai? ZAS Kitchen brings generations of culinary passion to your table. Born from a beloved kebab shop established over 25 years ago by Mr. Ismail Sharif, we've evolved into a premier cloud kitchen. Indulge in our signature kebabs, flavorful biryanis, and satisfying combo meals. We also offer a tempting selection of sandwiches, pizzas, burgers, quesadillas, and quick bites, all crafted with unwavering dedication to hygiene, taste, and quality. Experience the ZAS Kitchen difference, now delivering deliciousness across South Mumbai via Swiggy and Zomato.

featured_reviews.name: Andria Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text: The best Russian cutlets  I've ever had in Mumbai. Their variety of kebabs is excellent and taste is simply wow. I've been ordering Russian cutlets from here since 9 yrs now.   Unbeatable.

featured_reviews.name: Ayesha K
featured_reviews.review_text: This is exactly how good starters in an Indian wedding taste like. The rate is decent, quality premium (on most days).

featured_reviews.name: Vinayak K
featured_reviews.review_text:
Delicious food. Though i have tried many options from menu,  kababs and seekh biryani is my favourite choice.

Good thing is you get excellent taste at reasonable price.

Must to visit place as well as you can place home delivery orders.

featured_reviews.name: Ibad Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: Most Of My Order is From Swiggy  The Malai Tikka Biryani & Chicken Boneless Biryani is My Favorite. Excellent Food Quality & Well Balanced Menu Card At affordable Price. Best Taste & Quality.

featured_reviews.name: POONAM ISRANI
featured_reviews.review_text: gr8 service and tasty food. we had ordered chicken dum biryani for my daughter's bday. it was delivered before time... biryani was fresh and eatable even after 2 days. chicken kabab are must try.

featured_reviews.name: Hanif Lakdawala
featured_reviews.review_text: Reasonable priced non veg items. If you are hungry and want a decent choices at your door step, ZAS kicken is a fairly decent option. From dry items to Tiffin are offered at reasonable price. Nice collection of traditional sweet are available.

featured_reviews.name: Oosama Sharif
featured_reviews.review_text: Delicious food with consistent service. Have tried multiple items at Multiple occasions but the taste is always a top notch along with Hygiene. Kudos to ZAS team!

featured_reviews.name: Md Aamir Mozawala
featured_reviews.review_text: Ordered the food from through Swiggy. Quantity was good but felt like almost everything which I ordered was made out of Readymade packets. Like pattice of burger or chicken nuggets seems to be Readymade one. Taste was just fine.
